gizmo.title: Whakaoho whakaaroaro ki a koe anō
gizmo.description: Me tono ki te ākonga kia whakaaro ki tētahi tohu, ki tētahi āhua rānei, ā, me tuku he whakaoho hei whakatika i a ia anō i runga i tana whakautu.

configure.title: Momo whakaurunga
configure.description: Te huarahi e kōrero ai te ākonga i tōna āhua. E rua ngā momo e whakamahi ana i tētahi tauine 0 ki te 4 (tohu: F=0, D=1, C=2, B=3, A=4; āhua: tino iti=0 ki tino pai=4).

configure.title: Pātai
configure.description: He pātai mā te ākonga. Waiho kia kau hei whakamahi i te taunoa mō te momo whakaurunga.

configure.title: Ngā whakaoho
configure.description: Urupare e whakaaturia ana mō tētahi awhe whakautu. Ka whakamahia te awhe tuatahi e ōrite ana.
